evidence: The Communist Party of Great Britain since 1920 and The Congo: Plunder and Resistance are by David/Dave Renton, as are the listed fascism and Marxism titles. Springer lists David as author and calls him Dave in the same author biography; this is a name variant.

Stanley Alexander Saunders wrote Economic History of the Maritime Provinces (5), Studies in the Economy of the Maritime Provinces (1), and the Rowell-Sirois summary with Eleanor Back (1): 7/20 listed citation occurrences. The Benson infant burial and the other skeletal, dental and ancient-DNA papers are Shelley R. Saunders’s work.

We Women Worked so Hard and To Live a Better Life are by the Zimbabwe historian Teresa Ann (Terri) Barnes. Her Illinois publication records also identify her as coauthor of War in Rhodesia, 1965-1980. The listed Zimbabwe gender, mobility, labour and historiography writings belong to that same scholar.

The Penélope item is Uma leitura do Brasil colonial, coauthored by Maria Fernanda Baptista Bicalho; Conquista, mercês e poder local is her Almanack Braziliense article. She coedited O governo dos povos and Antigo Regime nos Trópicos: 20/21 listed occurrences. The single PTB title is a misparsed attribution to a chapter by Ângela de Castro Gomes.

Constructing Brotherhood, Fraternal Orders and Class Formation, Nineteenth-Century Women’s Auxiliaries and Fraternal Orders, When Women Play the Bass, and Looking for Feminism are all by Mary Ann Clawson. Mary AM is a transcription error.

Death, Memory and Material Culture is catalogued under Jennifer Lorna Hockey while its author statement says Jenny Hockey. Beyond the Body, Ideal Homes?, Grief, Mourning and Death Ritual, and The Matter of Death are also hers; Social homes? appears to be a malformed Ideal Homes? citation.

Roger Bigelow wrote Rise of the Spanish Empire, Six Contemporaneous Revolutions, Life and Letters of Thomas Cromwell (including the Morison fragment), and Süleyman: 11/19 listed occurrences. Queen Anne’s Navy, Sergison Papers and Captain George St. Lo variants are R. D. Merriman (7); Bison and the Fur Trade is Robert Owen (1). Mixed, without the roughly two-thirds dominance required for mostly.

Rádio Nacional and its variants, O Rádio no Brasil, Rádio Palanque, Rádio em transição, Rádio@Internet and the communication publications are Sonia Virgínia Moreira’s: approximately 18/20 listed occurrences. Porto de Itajaí is Sônia Miriam Teixeira Moreira’s; the Alcobaça conservation dissertation is Sónia Maria do Livramento Moreira’s.

In Praise of Later Roman Emperors (13) and Catulus’ Speech in Cassius Dio (1) are Barbara Saylor Rodgers’s: 14/16 listed occurrences. Portrait of Social Work with Julia Dixon and A New Portrait of Social Work with June Stevenson are by Barbara N. Rodgers, the British social-administration scholar.

Edward C. Russell coauthored Canadian Naval Operations in Korean Waters (6+1) and A History of Canadian Naval Aviation (2): 9/18 listed occurrences. The rest pool Emma K. Russell’s trauma-informed paper, E. W. Russell’s East African resources, E. S. Russell’s fishery/morphology works, Elizabeth S. Russell’s genetics report, and other Russells’ translation, history, agriculture and nursing writings.
